notes.title: Nomyou 1.097 Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]Patch Notes – v1.097 - 15 June 2025[/p][list][*][p]Dialogue Fixes – Resolved an issue where some dialogue lines were not being displayed as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]High FPS Bug – Fixed a bug that caused unexpected behaviour at extremely high frame rates (500+ FPS).[/p][/*][*][p]Spelling Corrections – Minor text and spelling errors have been corrected throughout the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Ultra-Widescreen Fix – UI elements that were previously off-screen on ultra-widescreen monitors have been properly adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Final Ascent Jump Tweak – A jump near the end of the game has been made slightly easier to complete without the double jump ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Controller Support Improvements – Adjustments have been made to improve compatibility and behaviour when using controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Sticker has been added by a Patreon backer.[/p][/*][*][p]Can now toggle fullscreen and resize the window in settings.[/p][/*][/list]
